kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتألمن (form IIq)
# أَتَأَلْمَنُ (ʔataʔalmanu) /ʔa.ta.ʔal.ma.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَأَلْمَنَ (taʔalmana)
# أَتَأَلْمَنَ (ʔataʔalmana) /ʔa.ta.ʔal.ma.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَأَلْمَنَ (taʔalmana)
# أَتَأَلْمَنْ (ʔataʔalman) /ʔa.ta.ʔal.man/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَأَلْمَنَ (taʔalmana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
